representative_quotes: Fijne en prettige rijschool voor motor rijlessen.
Uitleg is helder en je steekt er veel van op, de motoren om mee te lessen zijn goed onderhouden en fijn om mee te oefenen.
Prijskwaliteit verhouding is goed! Goede aanrader om hier motor rijlessen te nemen.
red_flags: Only 2 readable Google review bodies total - very small sample
No independent verified reviews (no klantenvertellen.nl presence)
Reviews are 3-4 years old; not recent
Facebook claims '100% aanbevolen (8 beoordelingen)' but review bodies were not accessible to verify
Easy to confuse with a different, unrelated 'Verkeersschool Attent' in Steenwijk - those reviews were excluded
verified_reviews_note: No klantenvertellen.nl listing found for this school.
review_summary: The handful of readable reviews (2 Google, both 5 stars) are positive and focus on motorcycle lessons: students praise clear explanations, well-maintained bikes, and good price-quality, with one calling it a recommendation. The corpus is too small and old to draw confident conclusions, and there are no independent verified reviews.
